text_block_list.text:
Holding off Mejiro Ryan and her other 
rivals, Mejiro McQueen claimed victory in 
her long-cherished dream, the Tenno Sho 
(Spring).

Filled with deep emotion, Mejiro McQueen 
reports her victory to the members of the 
Mejiro family and expresses her gratitude.

Hearing her words, the crowd erupted into 
unending cheers that echoed on for quite 
some time.
